title: Maçariqueiro(a)
description:
Job description

Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil.

Nascemos em 2017 com esse compromisso. Desde então, estamos presentes em 39 municípios, com mais de 2,5 mil colaboradores, 6 milhões de clientes e o propósito de atuar da melhor forma para levar saneamento às populações atendidas, ajudando o país a alcançar a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

O saneamento básico no Brasil está no momento de transformação e marcado por novos projetos de expansão. Para o nosso time, buscamos pessoas protagonistas e dispostas a inovar, atuando como agentes transformadores em prol do nosso objetivo. Alinhado ao nosso DNA, queremos promover um ambiente de trabalho sustentável, desenvolvedor e seguro.

Local de Atuação: Cidade, Estado (Nome da Operação)

Main responsibilities

  • Utilizar maçaricos para cortar chapas, tubos e outros materiais metálicos, seguindo desenhos e especificações técnicas;
  • Executa soldagens por brasagem, utilizando maçarico para fundir metais, prepara e mantém em bom estado os equipamentos e acessórios utilizados na soldagem e corte, como maçaricos, mangueiras e reguladores;
  • Realiza inspeção visual nas peças cortadas, identificando defeitos e executando limpeza para remover resíduos;
  • Organiza e limpa o local de trabalho, mantendo a área de atuação livre de obstáculos e perigos;
  • Deve conhecer as técnicas de soldagem, corte e brasagem, bem como as características dos materiais;
  • Operar tocha, máquina de soldagem, consumíveis, gases de proteção, alimentadores e utilizar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) corretos para cada fase do corte necessários;
  • Realizar cortes com auxílio de equipamentos específicos (esmerilhadeira, policorte, maçarico, etc.) percebendo o melhor material para cada área ou processo que necessite de execução;
  • Aplicar estritamente as normas de sustentabilidade, segurança do trabalho e a organização do local de trabalho;
  • Dirigir veículos da empresa para execução das tarefas em ambiente externo, reportando qualquer incidente, zelando pela segurança, normas de trânsito estabelecidas e manutenção dos veículos;
  • Realizar inspeção visual de solda, apontando os reparos necessários, bem como, realizando demais atividades correlatas e inerentes ao cargo;
  • Seguir as normas internas relacionadas as áreas de qualidade, meio ambiente, compliance, saúde e segurança do trabalho, dentre outras, em busca da melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • CNH B Definitiva e válida;
  • Desejável técnico em Soldagem;

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PCD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão?

Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 39 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.

O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.

Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?

Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu…

Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Venha trabalhar conosco, participar do presente, construir o futuro e valorizar o passado de uma instituição centenária que mexe com o coração de mais de 48 milhões de apaixonados.

Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!

Todo mundo sabe que quem joga pelo Flamengo tem que honrar o Manto Sagrado! Aqui, valorizamos muito o comprometimento, a dedicação, a superação, a resiliência. Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência!

…AMOR E PAIXÃO!

Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer!

Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família!

title: Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director
description:
Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director

Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director role at Canonical

Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representatives, Managers, and Directors to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as consumer electronics. We are looking for candidates who are technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are expanding in all time zones, so we can accommodate candidates from almost any country as long as they have reasonable business access to a substantial market territory in person. As we grow our teams, we will also hire Sales Team Managers and Regional Sales Directors. Please continue with this process if your goal is a management leadership position.
The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics, as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management, and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint.
This is a prospecting sales and strategic account development role and requires energy, ambition, and focus. To be successful, you must be comfortable positioning and selling open source, services, and software solutions to all levels of an organization, and specifically to departments that are developing embedded software and IoT devices. You should also be familiar with at least one of our priority sectors.
Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute, and every category of application. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting, and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote, and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position; it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision-making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long-term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world-leading company, we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment that promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration, and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted, which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with brands in their territory. Overview

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS / CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50% : OCR → parse → validate → post touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance : Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑ : Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments / write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑ : Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑ : AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed : Live Sheets / Excel / Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor : MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines : OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation : Primary-source license checks, date / format rules, name / DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG / OT).
  • Workflow integrations : Event-driven APIs / webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM / Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation : AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS / CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies / MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record : Integrate VoIP / SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS / Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation : Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage / routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation : Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing / job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation : Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required) : Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to :
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits / adjustments.
  • Sync AR / AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants : RAG chatbots over Confluence / SharePoint / Drive / ATS / CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting : Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset / prompt / embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline / online evals; A / B tests.
  • CI / CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency / reliability SLOs; canary / blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries / backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces / metrics / cost), drift detection, PII / HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance : token / throughput controls, caching / TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and / or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM / RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF / HTML / images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA / PII ), APIs / webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS / Compliance / Job Boards / HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing / payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals : data / model versioning, CI / CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing / credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS / workflow tools (Zapier / Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS / App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI / LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership : Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover : Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack : Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM / Marketing (HubSpot / Salesforce) , VoIP / SMS, CMS, accounting / payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes : Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture : Production over prototypes, HIPAA / PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

title: Cientista de Dados Especialista - Programação (RJ)
description:
Cientista de Dados Especialista - Programação (RJ)

LiveMode Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Cientista de Dados Especialista - Programação (RJ) role at LiveMode

O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Dito isso, estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Cientista de Dados Especialista para jogar junto à nossa equipe de Programação no Rio de Janeiro. Na LiveMode, cada movimento é uma jogada para a liderança e inovação no mercado.

Como Cientista de Dados Especialista , sua missão será a análise e definição de metas de audiência com base em dados, geração de insights acionáveis e automação de processos, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards estratégicos para orientar decisões de produto, comercial e programação. Impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente.

Responsabilidades:

  • Análise de audiência e definição de metas: monitorar os dados de transmissões ao vivo e grades de programação, identificando horários e formatos com melhor desempenho; definir metas para eventos com base em análises históricas e variáveis relevantes; cruzar diferentes bases de dados para gerar insights que embasem metas comerciais e de produto.
  • Geração de insights acionáveis: transformar dados complexos em planos de ação práticos para áreas como comercial, produto e planejamento; trazer insights ainda não explorados que contribuam para a otimização da audiência e da performance geral das transmissões; investigar quedas de audiência e propor soluções fundamentadas em dados.
  • Automação e processamento de dados: desenvolver automações para relatórios e análises que hoje são feitos manualmente, utilizando Python, Excel avançado, Power BI e ferramentas de IA (como ChatGPT) para ganho de eficiência; estruturar bases de dados que permitam análises mais ágeis e profundas.
  • Criação e apresentação de relatórios: elaborar relatórios e dashboards que contem a história por trás dos dados, resumindo informações de forma clara e objetiva; adaptar a comunicação dos resultados para diferentes públicos, desde equipes operacionais até alta liderança.
  • Testes e implementação de ferramentas: participar da implantação de novas plataformas de distribuição e análise de audiência, assegurando integração com outras áreas e consistência nas métricas acompanhadas.
  • Relacionamento com áreas internas via dados: atuar em conjunto com planejamento comercial, produtos e distribuição, servindo como elo de conexão baseado em dados; negociar metas e decisões estratégicas utilizando argumentos sólidos e análises estatísticas.
  • Atuação analítica e estatística: interpretar dados complexos para identificar padrões e tendências, aplicando conceitos de estatística e análise preditiva na definição de estratégias de programação e audiência.
  • Flexibilidade operacional em grandes eventos: acompanhar transmissões e assumir responsabilidades analíticas e de monitoramento em finais de semana e eventos esportivos de relevância, garantindo qualidade na leitura dos dados em tempo real.
Requisitos necessários:
  • Perfil altamente analítico: capacidade de interpretar métricas complexas e transformá-las em planos estratégicos.
  • Ferramentas e programação: conhecimento básico de Python e SQL. Excel avançado e PowerPoint; experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares.
  • Estatística e análise preditiva: conhecimento em estatística aplicada, manipulação de dados e identificação de padrões de audiência.
  • Comunicação baseada em dados: habilidade para construir narrativas claras com dados e defender metas junto a diferentes públicos.
  • Sensibilidade esportiva: compreensão do contexto dos jogos e eventos para interpretar e contextualizar os dados.
  • Organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas: capacidade de priorizar atividades e lidar com situações de alta pressão.
  • Inglês intermediário: proficiência para comunicação em reuniões com equipes internacionais.
  • Exploração ativa de IA e automações: interesse e prática prévia com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, automações via IA etc.), demonstrando uso no dia a dia acadêmico ou pessoal.
Diferenciais desejáveis:
  • Formação ou experiência em estatística ou ciência de dados: bagagem acadêmica ou prática em áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência no mercado esportivo: atuação anterior em programação, análise de dados ou projetos ligados a clubes, transmissões ou scouting.
  • Automação de relatórios e processos: histórico de criação de pipelines de dados e dashboards gerenciais.
  • Visão comercial aplicada a dados: habilidade para planejar grades e estratégias de programação com foco em maximizar retorno de audiência e receita.
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo: facilidade em atuar de forma integrada e em construir soluções em conjunto com múltiplas áreas.
Nossos benefícios:
  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.
Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontim, hoje e sempre

Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos

Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande

A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - EXCLUSIVO PARA PESSOA COM DEFICIÊNCIA
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho a serem definidos;
  • Locais de trabalho: Zona Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em modalidades contratuais diferentes, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência na gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a toda a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

BDR/SDR Pleno

Essa posição assume um papel estratégico na evolução do nosso processo de vendas. A posição envolve qualificação avançada de leads, elevação da assertividade e eficácia de cada interação comercial e, consequentemente, aumento do valor e da qualidade dos contratos conquistados. A missão principal é realizar prospecção ativa de leads por meio de estratégias de outbound, networking qualificado e abordagem consultiva, buscando, abordando e qualificando potenciais clientes com alto fit para o nosso modelo de negócio.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar ativamente na prospecção de leads (outbound) utilizando redes sociais, e-mail, telefone e networking estratégico;

  • Conduzir reuniões de fechamento de forma autônoma e eficaz;
  • Criar propostas personalizadas e argumentações estruturadas;
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de quebras de objeção;

  • Analisar e aumentar a taxa de conversão.

  • Conhecimento sobre perfis de clientes, psicologia da tomada de decisão e funil de vendas.
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa (outbound) e geração de leads;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com postura consultiva e escuta ativa;
  • Domínio de técnicas de vendas (SPIN Avançado).

Overview

Solvd is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Following the acquisition of Tooploox, Solvd now offers end-to-end delivery— from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong expertise in end-to-end business analysis . This role requires someone who can effectively collaborate with stakeholders, facilitate requirement discovery, and ensure that business needs are translated into high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in pre-sales activities and the ability to contribute directly to client delivery projects. When not engaged in active delivery, the candidate will support pre-sales initiatives, including proposal development, discovery sessions, and solution shaping, and may be considered for involvement in CMS-related projects. In addition, the candidate should be technically savvy, with a solid understanding of system solution design and its core components, including backend services, frontend applications, APIs, and integrations.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate across stakeholder groups to gather, analyze, and document requirements at all stages of the project lifecycle (from initiation/discovery through development and maintenance).
  • Communicate directly with customers to elicit high-level requirements and convert them into detailed documentation such as Vision & Scope, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, UML diagrams, and process flows.
  • Develop and maintain product backlogs (epics, features, user stories) to guide Agile development teams.
  • Facilitate workshops and decision-making sessions to align customer expectations and technical delivery.
  • Execute impact-mapping of requirements and manage change requests throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead verification of designs against requirements, providing recommendations to resolve any issues.
  • Support PMs with timelines, roadmaps, milestones, and sprint planning.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in Jira, Confluence/other tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience across the full BA cycle (pre-sales, discovery, delivery, and support).
  • Strong ability to elicit, document, and manage requirements using BA artifacts (Vision & Scope, SRS, User Stories, Use Cases, diagrams, etc.).
  • Experience with impact mapping and change request management.
  • Skilled in backlog management, sprint planning, and Agile delivery support.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Confident in facilitating workshops, leading meetings, and driving decision-making.
  • Strong command of English (B2+/C1 level).
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence or similar tools.
  • Ability to work independently (the only BA on the project) and collaboratively in a BA team environment.
  • Motivated, proactive, and passionate about customer success and growth.
  • Experienced in supporting multicultural, distributed teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI/ML, or digital transformation projects.
  • BA certifications (CBAP, CCBA, Agile BA, PO, etc.).

What you’ll get

  • Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation.
  • Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures.
  • Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards.

Ready to make an impact? If you’re excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry’s sharpest minds, apply today and let’s innovate together.

Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 135 lojas físicas e ao mesmo tempo mais de 4.900 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios e Volta Redonda.

Além disso, nossos canais digitais ampliam nossa atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.

Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além dos medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.

Em 2014, criamos a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e na distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo um serviço especializado e eficiente. Para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição, estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.

O que nos torna únicos? Nossa essência carioca, o acolhimento genuíno e a busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e ganhamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importante.

A Venancio não para! Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha crescer com a gente!

title: MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (CATARATA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO
description:
Resumo

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

Serviços oferecidos

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.
  • Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica, Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia, Registro de Qualificação de Especialidade (RQE);
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;
  • Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estágio (Fellowship) em Catarata.

Condições de Trabalho

  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Observação: Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.
  • Avaliação por competências

Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde PAIS

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Within their defined territory, the CSAM is responsible for developing and implementing effective customer success and value strategies, identifying growth opportunities, negotiating favorable renewal terms, and providing insights to the business and customers that improve future outcomes. Preferred

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to convey value through interactions with customers

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

We are looking for a highly motivated team player to join our hungry squad as a Brand & Marketing Designer. You will partner with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to own day-to-day marketing design, evolve and guard our brand system, turn complex AI features into clear visuals, and more.

About The Opportunity

We're building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolving and guarding our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants and ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight, moodboard, concept, production, iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests and weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • Exceptional taste and refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI and the ability to defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with, and a low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.

Tools

  • Figma & Wordpress / Elementor power user and Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points if You

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

Start part-time freelance and earn your way into a full-time seat in = 12 months through results. Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks. Direct access to founders, zero bureaucracy, and ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, and outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

Legal Intake Specialist (Argentina | Remote)

Join to apply for the Legal Intake Specialist (Argentina | Remote) role at OpsArmy

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Apply here:

Position Overview

The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. The precision and quality of the intake process directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical record retrieval for law firm clients.

Responsibilities

  1. Provider Research & Identification
    • Identify all relevant healthcare providers involved in a client\'s treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
    • Research and locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, historical request data, and direct provider outreach.
    • Accurately input all identified providers into the admin application.
  2. Request Creation & Quality Control
    • Review incoming ROIs (Release of Information forms), correcting incomplete or inaccurate submissions (noting that 90% require adjustments).
    • Prepare accurate base forms before generating submission packets.
    • Conduct comprehensive quality assurance checks on each ROI packet, verifying inclusion of all required details such as cover letters, affidavits, and other documentation.
  3. Request Assignment
    • Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.
  4. Handling Special Cases
    • Identify and escalate special provider requirements (e.g., unique forms or protocols) to the assigned Client Success Manager (CSM).

Join to apply for the Alliances Field Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards

  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

Sobre o Pensador

O Pensador.com, anteriormente conhecido como Pensador.info ou Pensador.uol.com.br, é propriedade da empresa 7Graus, que produz conteúdos para a América Latina e a Europa, com um escritório sediado em Portugal.

Com uma longa jornada de crescimento e melhorias contínuas, o site nasceu em 2005, a partir de uma lista de frases e citações. Percebendo que outras pessoas tinham o mesmo interesse, resolveu partilhar o seu acervo, de forma gratuita, com o resto do mundo.

Em 2023, decidimos levar a nossa missão mais longe e ampliar o âmbito do Pensador. Assim, nasceu o Pensador.com/es/, dedicado ao público falante de espanhol, que rapidamente tem conquistado novos leitores e amantes das letras. Em 2024, nasce o Pensador.com/en/, para o público que fala inglês. Em 2025 chegou o Mensagens de Aniversário, maior site de desejos de aniversário do Brasil.

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve.

About The Role

The Intake QA Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and quality of the intake process. This role involves reviewing and auditing intake data, re-engaging unresponsive claimants, and supporting quality assurance initiatives across multiple platforms. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, technical proficiency, and a proactive approach to maintaining intake accuracy and compliance.

Location: Remote – availability to work some evenings and weekends when needed. Initial training will be Monday through Friday for approximately 2–3 weeks.

What You\'ll Do

  • Audit intake cases to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established criteria.

  • Time Management & Organization: Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities efficiently.
  • Problem-Solving: Proactive approach to resolving intake inconsistencies and unresponsive claimants challenges.
  • Dependability & Initiative: Reliable in workflow execution and takes initiative in addressing quality concerns.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a legal intake, customer service, or quality assurance role.
  • Knowledge of intake processes.
  • Prior experience working with call centers.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance

    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution

  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
  • Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
  • Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

We believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation, apply today.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

Innodata is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

title: Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding (Remote)
description:
At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About the Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics.
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code.
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition.
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals).
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency).
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors.
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors.
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot.
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable.
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus).
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging.
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability.
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving.
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup).
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints.
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte).
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines.
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object.
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards.
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT.
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus.

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours.
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network.
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget.

Raízen Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Raízen Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Se identificou?

A área de Gestão do Ciclo de Vida de Produtos (PLM) atua de forma transversal no negócio de Lubrificantes , garantindo que o portfólio evolua estrategicamente para atender às demandas do mercado e às diretrizes globais da Shell .

Atuando como facilitador(a), assegurará o alinhamento entre inovação, portfólio e operação, monitorando KPIs críticos, otimizando estoques e implementando melhorias contínuas. Seu papel será essencial para impulsionar a competitividade da empresa, garantindo prazos, compliance e a execução de iniciativas estratégicas no mercado.

Horário : Adm. – 09h às 18h

Local : Ilha do Governador, RJ - Raízen Lubrificantes

  • Gerenciar e atualizar KPIs estratégicos, incluindo Time to Market, Saúde do Portfólio, Obsolescência e aderência ao Plano de Portfólio.
  • Monitorar estoques de produtos de baixo giro e/ou descontinuados, promovendo ações para otimizar o portfólio.
  • Capturar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, identificando boas práticas e soluções inovadoras para fortalecer a gestão do ciclo de vida de produtos.
  • Ser o ponto focal no desenvolvimento de labels e embalagens, atuando em conjunto com o time da Shell Global.
  • Atuar na revisão dos processos com foco em eficiência e simplificação.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo.
  • Inglês Avançado – necessário para interações frequentes com a Shell Global.
  • Capacidade analítica e organização na construção e gestão de processos.
  • Experiência prévia em gestão de projetos.
  • Habilidades digitais (Power BI, programação).
  • Forte capacidade de interlocução e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e capacidade de propor soluções inovadoras.
  • Poder de influência para articular demandas entre diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos.

Informações adicionais

Etapas do processo seletivo

Nossos processos contemplam 3 etapas principais (podem ter outras, e você ficará por dentro caso avance):

  • Inscrição - preenchimento deste formulário e de dados adicionais, caso necessário.
  • Entrevista com o RH - um bate-papo para nos conhecermos.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: bate-papo mais técnico para contar ainda mais sobre o dia a dia e os desafios.

Nossa comunicação será por e-mail e telefone - confira se seus dados estão atualizados.

  • Investigate issues reported by customers by researching and escalating issues
  • Work to resolve complex customer problems related to Canonical's portfolio of products.

  • Engage directly with customers and work collaboratively by phone, ticketing system, and remote sessions to resolve their issues.
  • Participate in a regular weekend working rotation.
  • Contribute new knowledge base articles and maintain existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.
What are we looking for in you
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Hands-on and extensive working experience in supporting Linux systems including 3 or more of:
    • Virtualization / Cloud - primarily using KVM or OpenStack.
    • Containers - especially with Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.
    • Storage technologies - block, object and network.
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.).
  • Cloud computing expertise in provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.
  • Advanced troubleshooting experience:
    • Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
    • Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
    • Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to escalate to the correct team.
  • Programming fundamentals in any language.
  • Extensive Customer support experience is key:
    • Customer needs are top priority.
    • Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: ENFERMEIRO NIR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
